ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In the winter of 2010, affected by expectations such as South Korea's "kimchi crisis", the price of Shandong Chinese cabbage soared. However, since September 2011, the price of Shandong Chinese cabbage has continued to fall, and no one wanted it even at 5 fen per jin. From "expensive vegetables hurt the people" to "cheap vegetables hurt farmers", it has attracted widespread attention from society. What was the main factor that caused the planting area of Chinese cabbage in this place in 2011 to increase greatly compared with 2010?
